title: Locale pack
description: The symbols, digits, names and patterns the core formats labels with (REQ-I18N-020), in d3-format and d3-time-format's shape. The shell builds it once per locale from `Intl` with the Gregorian calendar forced (`-u-ca-gregory`) and passes it to wasm; no wasm module links a locale database. The CLI reads it from `--locale-file` (REQ-I18N-070), and the `localeData` option overrides the pack derived from `locale`. Without a pack the core uses `.`, `,`, groups of three, ASCII digits and `-` (REQ-I18N-030).

group.description: The group separator: `,` (en), `.` (de), U+202F (fr). U+2009, U+202F and U+00A0 are drawn as one plain space cell (REQ-FMT-060). Empty for none.

grouping.description: Group sizes from the decimal point leftward, the last repeating, as d3-format's `grouping`: [3] for en-US, [3, 2] for en-IN.

minus.description: The minus sign: U+2212 in the browser and `-` in the CLI by default (REQ-FMT-060).

percent.description: The percent pattern, `#` standing for the number: `#%` (en), `# %` (de, with U+00A0), `#٪` (ar).

numerals.description: The ten digits 0 to 9, each one cell wide: ASCII, or `٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩` for ar-EG.

currency.description: The currency's [prefix, suffix], as d3-format's `currency`: ["$", ""] for en-US, ["", " €"] for de-DE. The currency itself is the page's choice.

periods.description: The [AM, PM] markers for `%p` and the 12-hour cycle, as d3-time-format's `periods`.

dateTime.description: The date-and-time pattern in the strftime subset of REQ-FMT-050, as d3-time-format's `dateTime`: `%a %b %e %H:%M:%S %Y`.

hourCycle.description: h23 draws 24-hour time labels; h12 draws 12-hour labels with `periods` (REQ-FMT-050).

direction.description: The text direction; an rtl locale puts the y axis and the legend on the right (REQ-I18N-060).
